collector_comparison.interpretation: Descriptive CPU collector profile only. Timing includes policy inference and simulator collection; not CUDA evidence, not a learning comparison, and not a promotion/acceptance result.

configuration.simulator_semantics: unchanged scalar Simulation.step; one episode-like rollout

coverage_and_limits.checkpoint_note: Checkpoint samples use the local inference-policy NPZ+JSON bridge, not resumable optimizer/trainer generations.
coverage_and_limits.comparison_note: Scalar-per-animal and multi-world-batched CPU collection are compared descriptively with paired parity checks; this does not establish GPU speedup or policy quality.
coverage_and_limits.phase_timing_note: Wrapper-level CPU wall timings; instrumentation overhead is included in inclusive full-rollout/step timings, while phase sums overlap inclusively.

profile_report_json_write.note: Measured first report write; subsequent self-inclusive write is not timed.
